Operational Supervision: Supervises assigned staff and maintains optimal staffing patterns to meet departmental operational needs while setting high standards for quality of work.
Workforce Management: Prepares work schedules and manages the workforce, partnering with Human Resources and Lab Management on hiring, disciplinary, and dismissal processes.
Process Optimization: Maintains work processes to ensure laboratory turnaround times and quality standards are consistently met.
Policy Development: Develops and maintains policies, procedures, and protocols that align with hospital guidelines and organizational standards.
Staff Development: Monitors performance, identifies training opportunities, oversees staff education, maintains competency records, and submits timely performance assessments for manager approval.

Leadership & Compliance: Participates in committees, collaborates with the Lab Leadership Team to improve organizational processes, and oversees billing compliance and manual charge entry for send-out testing.
